text: Assumption: All running operations of the instance should be finished before the destructor call — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: All running operations of the instance should be finished before the destructor call — is this correct?
norm: all running operations of the instance should be finished before the destructor call
assumption: All running operations of the instance should be finished before the destructor call.
rationale: The destructor is declared as not thread-safe, which is why concurrent accesses lead to race conditions.

original.text: Annahme: Vor dem Destruktoraufruf sollten alle laufenden Vorgänge der Instanz beendet sein — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Vor dem Destruktoraufruf sollten alle laufenden Vorgänge der Instanz beendet sein
original.rationale: Der Destruktor ist als not thread-safe deklariert, weshalb parallele Zugriffe zu Race Conditions führen.
